sentence: This project studies whether inherited immune genes change cancer risk, using clinical and genomic datasets and an in vivo model.
This project builds a sensor that glows to show RNA methylation inside cells, so that drugs that block methylation can be found quickly.
This project tries to find out how opioids disrupt brain regions that control drug seeking, and how biological sex changes those effects.
This project builds a method that reads peptides to identify the species behind an infection and predict how well a macrolide drug will work.
This project creates tools that describe how genetic variations might have harmful effects in humans.
This project studies how lysosomes keep intestinal stem cells going and how they feed tumors, using the mammalian intestine.
This project builds imaging tools that do not need surgery and uses them in patients with brain disorders such as depression.
This project measures signs like heart rate and breathing with a small wearable device after surgery to create a pain biomarker for tailoring pain medication.
This project tries to find out how fatty acids in tumors harm T cells and how to restore T cell function in cancer patients.
This project builds a workflow that separates and sequences the sugars in human milk so that their structures can be described accurately.
This project tries to find out how to spot patients at high risk of sepsis before they get to the hospital.
This project studies how gut microbiota and the products they release into the blood affect immune responses and organ dysfunction in sepsis.
This project tests combinations of antibodies in an animal model to find out how HIV escapes them and how to suppress the virus.
This project supports studies of severe viral pneumonia by providing lung fluid samples from patients and describing their clinical features and microbes.
This project develops a protein treatment that could be stockpiled and used to limit damage to the eye caused by chemical vesicants.
This project develops statistical tools to find which older adults with dementia and which hospital factors lead to poor recovery after a fracture.
This project combines protein design, chemistry and deep learning to create a form of biological light for imaging living animals.
This project tests a combination of activities to raise awareness and use of HIV prevention among high-risk people in Louisiana.
This project develops rapid methods using ion mobility and mass spectrometry to analyze the sequences and structures of protein drugs and the complexes they form.
This project studies how blood endothelial cells and the factors they release help the intestine repair itself, and how they change in disease.
